about: Guards written before their fix, each failing at ad5a0f9. While a guard fails, its test passes and says why; when it passes, its test fails until its entry is removed. The fixing PR removes its entries. A release needs this list empty. SA_KNOWN_FAILURES=strict runs every guard as an ordinary test.
